posts.title: Welcome to the blog
posts.excerpt: A quick hello and what to expect from My Blog.
posts.content:
## Hello there

This is your first post. You can edit it, delete it, or ask the AI assistant to rewrite it.

Here's what you can do next:

- **Pick a template** in the Design tab
- **Write a post** in the Posts tab (or let AI draft one)
- **Publish** to GitHub Pages in one click

> Tip: everything you change is previewed live.

posts.title: Three things I learned this week
posts.content:
Every week I try to write down a few things I learned. Here are this week's.

### 1. Start before you're ready

Waiting for the perfect moment is a great way to never start.

### 2. Keep it simple

The simplest version of an idea is usually the one people remember.

### 3. Share it

Writing in public is the fastest way to learn.

posts.title: How this site was made
posts.excerpt: Built with a no-code AI blog builder and published to GitHub Pages.
posts.content:
This site was created with **Blog Builder** — no code required.

1. Described the blog in a sentence
2. Chose a template and a color style
3. Hit publish

The whole thing is static HTML, so it loads fast and costs nothing to host.
